description: Recto: Torah reading for Šavuʿot: Exodus 19:1–4 with Targum Onqelos. The Hebrew text of Exodus 19:1 is written in full. Only incipits of Exodus 19:2–4 in Hebrew are included. Full text of all verses in Aramaic is included. Verso: colophon mentioning Saʿadya b. Elʿazar (owner) and Abū Saʿd ha-Levi (scribe). (Information from CUDl.)
